The '''Bromlarch system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that located within the [[Vish sector/Legends|Vish sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region, and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bromlarch/Legends|Bromlarch]].
